author: jeetno1saar
quote: they killed gt sport and released this hot pile of garbage as a "new" game but it's the same game all over again. i can't give it a rating on psn because i have the ps4 version and they removed that version from the store. if the game is not in the store, you cannot rate it. sony being a scumbag, as usual.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: i loved gt2 and gt3. gt4 was okay. didn't play gt5 or gt6. gt sport is garbage. i was about to give it a 4/10 but then i remembered they put lewis hamilton in this game. why? who asked for that? also, sony killed the game. i can't play the game and i can't rate the game. online racing was rubbish with everyone exploiting the ever changing penalty system.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: not as good as the original but still very good. i never had anyone who i could play the co-op part of the game.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: very cool game. unique, innovative, beautiful. a timeless classic and one of the very few games i would consider a must play.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: i don't understand uncharted. they are all boring and stupid. i know i played them but i don't remember anything that happens. completely forgettable waste of time.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: everything uncharted is absolute trash. got this for "free" on ps4, started playing all three games and quickly realized they are all the same game. terrible cover-based gameplay, terrible weapons, terrible sound are just a filler in-between scenes of a terrible movie. i don't think a person with an iq over 80 can enjoy these games.

author: jeetno1saar
quote:
this is the only good rockstar game i played.

one of the best games i watched and read, not really played. it's a book and a movie, not really a game. gameplay is jank. i hate the fact that you cannot play as arthur in a lot of the areas on the map. arthur is carrying the whole game, honestly. john is terrible. i hate his face, his voice, his wife, everything.

the game is a nice thing to experience once every 5-10 years. zero replay qualities.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: my understanding is this game was hated because it was a ps4 launch title. i only played it in around 2019 and it was big fun. collecting bits to grow stronger is a beautiful mechanic. i liked the game enough to buy the sequel which wasn't as good. now that all new games are rubbish, this looks like a hidden gem.

author: jeetno1saar
quote: BOOOOOORING — — — the worst thing a game can do is be boring. this game is not engaging on any level. there's nothing innovative about it. — — — it's probably not even in top 5 games this year and it was a terrible year for games. this is before i even bring bugs, glitches and performance issues into account. — — — gta6 is only a smidge less buggy than cyberpunk and that game didn't have 20 years of game mechanics to use. that, and more than a decade long development time makes gta worse. realistically, it deserves 1.5 to 2 points less than cyberpunk, which means 5.5 to 6 out of 10 user score.
